page.overview:
Who is Flak-Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

The Flak-Vipers were introduced in the 1992 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: neon blue helmet with black visor; green shirt with neon blue sleeves and green gloves; grey half-vest with neon blue shoulder anchor; neon blue pants with grey leggings and black boots.

Accessories: dark green twin missile launcher backpack; light blue laser rifle with bayonet; two light blue missiles with squared-off fins; black figure stand. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/92/flakviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/92/flakviper.shtml Filecard]
